validity.researcher_notes: Northern Natural Gas Pipeline is the main transmission system of Northern Natural Gas Company (Berkshire Hathaway Energy subsidiary). Real, operating since 1930, stretching from Permian Basin through Midwest. Sheet values (14,300 miles, 6,300 MMcf/d, operating) are consistent with public disclosures and EIA historical data. Existing refs cite EIA data.php (navigation page, not a detailed article) requiring verification via operator 10-K, FERC Form 2, or PHMSA. No existence/classification/duplicate concerns. Status confirmed as operating via multiple independent sources. | ORCHESTRATOR 2026-09-14: FABRICATED ATTRIBUTION REMOVED. This unit was staged against https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php, which is a navigation page, and the claim was that EIA states this value. It does not. EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook carries only individual PROJECTS (expansions, laterals, compressor stations) — 46 of them for Northern Natural Gas across the 28 releases — and contains no system-level attributes at all: no mainline length, no system capacity, no 1930 start year, no operator or owner field for a whole system. The prior pass's own notes concede it ('EIA AND PIPELINE INDUSTRY SOURCES confirm...'), i.e. the value came from somewhere else and EIA was attached to it afterwards. The citation is withdrawn; the value on the sheet is untouched and the unit is re-opened.
